tasks.short: Make a weld template from the blueprint.

steps.what: Read the blueprint and write the joint dimensions
Run the calculations for this welding template
Check those calculations against the blueprint
Cut and fit the welding template on the part

tasks.design: She reads the blueprint in {DOCS} and writes joint type, thickness, angle, diameter, and leg length herself. A formula page in {SPREADSHEET} returns developed length and bevel only from those fields, and only for a listed joint. She still checks that length on the drawing with the lead welder, and she still cuts and fits the template on the part.
tasks.previous_blocker: The dimensions sit in the drawing, and the joint shape changes from job to job, so a calculator had no reliable fields to read.
tasks.enabler_now: She already writes the five fields, and the listed joints use fixed formulas, so the second arithmetic pass can use that page.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing whether the template sits on the real part, and any joint the list does not name.
tasks.human_edge: She chooses the joint from the drawing and rejects a length that does not fit the metal in front of her.
tasks.altitude: She still reads the drawing, still fits the template, and still decides the joint. The formula only replaces a second arithmetic pass on fields she already wrote.

reach.task: Lay out the cut lines from the same blueprint.
reach.learn: Which dimensions the formula may use, and which joints she still develops by hand.

evidence.claim: Standard butt, fillet, miter, and pipe developments are fixed trigonometry once joint type, thickness, angle, diameter, and leg length are known. This is model knowledge, not a measured shop.
Dutch law requires works-council consent when a facility records staff in a way that can observe attendance, behaviour, or performance. National rules differ.
Annex III 4(b) lists AI that monitors and evaluates workers as high-risk.

assumptions: Structured fields are joint type, thickness, angle, diameter, and leg length. The producer is the welder in the blueprint step, and that capture stays at remaining 100. The formula only uses those fields.
Listed joints are butt, fillet, miter, and pipe-to-pipe. Any other joint, or a missing field, means she still calculates by hand and the saving does not apply.
Reading the blueprint, the lead welder's check, and cutting and fitting the template stay at remaining 100. No mechanism shortens the bench work.
Zero extra hours for her: the formula page is not her upkeep. The lead welder's check is already counted on the review step.
The formula does not score her work and is not tied to a login, so it is not a performance record.
unknowns: Whether drawings already state joint type, thickness, angle, diameter, and leg length as numbers, or only as a picture.
research_questions: Which joints in this shop already carry those five numbers, and which are still a sketch?

already_counted.description: Reading the blueprint and cutting and fitting the template are already her remaining time on those steps.
The lead welder's check of the lengths against the blueprint is already that other role's time on the review step.

incremental.description: No extra steady hours. An unlisted joint or a missing field means she keeps the hand calculation, so the saving does not apply.

approvals.approved_version: Developed length and bevel computed from the five fields she wrote, checked against the blueprint before she cuts the template.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The only cut is the hand calculation, 13 percent of the task. Low is zero when the joint is unlisted or a dimension is missing and she still calculates. High is 10 when most joints are listed and she still rechecks a few lengths by hand. Fitting the template stays at full length.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan the weld from the drawing and the safety sheet.

steps.what: Read the drawings and write the material grade
Find safety lines for that material grade
Plan layout and assembly from the blueprints
Write the operations on the job card

tasks.design: She reads the drawings in {DOCS} and writes the material grade herself. A safety card, kept by the safety officer and indexed by that grade, shows fume, PPE, and ventilation, and she still reads the card. She still plans the layout and the operation order at the bench and writes that plan herself.
tasks.previous_blocker: The safety lines sit in a long sheet, and the weld sequence depends on the part in front of her.
tasks.enabler_now: The grade is a field she writes, and the safety card is a lookup, which does not choose the sequence.
tasks.still_hard: Reading an odd drawing and choosing the order of welds so the part does not distort or fail.
tasks.human_edge: She sets the sequence from the part and the drawing, including when the card has no row.
tasks.altitude: She still reads the drawing and still sets the operation order. The safety card only shortens the hunt for fume, PPE, and ventilation.

reach.role: Welding, Soldering, and Brazing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
reach.task: Set the machine from the operation order she wrote.
reach.learn: The sequence on the job card is her plan, not a generated weld program.

evidence.claim: A card indexed by material grade can show fume, PPE, and ventilation that a safety officer already filed. It does not read a drawing or choose a weld sequence. This is model knowledge.
Annex III 4(b) lists AI that monitors and evaluates workers as high-risk.

assumptions: The structured field is material grade. The producer is the welder when she reads the drawing, and that capture stays at remaining 100.

Safety-card fields are material grade, fume, PPE, and ventilation. The producer is the safety officer. She still reads the row, so the find step stays at remaining 70. A missing grade means she searches the full safety sheet inside that step, and the shorter time does not apply.
Reading the drawings, planning layout and assembly, and writing the operations stay at remaining 100. Nothing proposes the sequence.
The safety officer's upkeep is about one hour per 100 of her baseline hours on this task. That is another role and is not taken off her saving.
Zero extra hours for her, because a missing grade is already inside the find step. She does not maintain the card.
unknowns: Whether a safety officer already keeps a card per material grade, and how often a grade is missing.
research_questions: Who files material grade, fume, PPE, and ventilation today, and how often is a grade absent?

already_counted.description: Reading the drawings, reading the safety row, planning the sequence, and writing the job card are already her remaining time on those steps.

incremental.description: No extra steady hours for her. A missing grade is handled inside the find step, and she does not maintain the card.
The safety officer updates material grade, fume, PPE, and ventilation when a safety sheet changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The find step is 8 percent and drops only to 70 when the safety card has the grade. Low is zero when the grade is missing and she searches the full sheet. High is 2 when most grades are on the card. Planning the sequence stays at full length.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week stays at the bench. A length formula does not choose the joint, and a safety card does not set the weld sequence.
reach: Welding, Soldering, and Brazing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
Inspectors, Testers, Sorters, Samplers, and Weighers
skills_to_grow: Develop an unlisted joint by hand when the formula has no row.
Reject a calculated length that does not sit on the part.
Write the weld sequence herself from the drawing.
role.ambitious_version: One set of joint dimensions feeds the length formula, while the template fit and the weld sequence stay in her hands.
